entities.summary: Cole Hinton Anthony is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Milwaukee Bucks of the National Basketball Association. He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels. Listed at 6 feet 2 inches and 185 pounds, he plays the point guard position.
